name: agystack
description: Rigorous agentic engineering framework for Google Antigravity: poteto-mode, playbooks, isolated subagents, adversarial reviews, and cloud swarms. Port of Lauren Tan's pstack.

author.name: Lauren Tan (original pstack), Joel Taroreh (Antigravity port)

suggestedPrompts: Plan and implement this feature with /poteto-mode rigor
Interrogate this implementation with multi-model adversarial reviews
Run /arena to compare multiple architectural approaches
